user.title: Connect to BookOrbit
user.description: Enter the details of your self-hosted BookOrbit server. A password-based account is required (OIDC-only accounts cannot be used).

data_description.host: The address you open in a browser, e.g. http://192.168.1.50:3000
data_description.username: Your BookOrbit username (not your email address)
data_description.scan_interval: How often to poll BookOrbit for new statistics (1-1440 minutes)

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authenticate BookOrbit
reauth_confirm.description: BookOrbit rejected the stored credentials for {host}. Enter updated login details.

error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to the BookOrbit server

abort.already_configured: This BookOrbit server is already configured
